vectors.name: two-byte-boundary
vectors.notes: 256 is 0x0100: the minimal form keeps an interior zero

vectors.name: non-minimal-zero
vectors.notes: zero is the empty list, never 0x00

vectors.name: non-minimal-one
vectors.notes: same integer as 0x01; a conforming decoder rejects the padding instead of normalising it

vectors.name: word-padded-zero
vectors.notes: the ABI word form of zero; the canonical form is the empty list

vectors.name: word-padded-one
vectors.notes: the ABI word form of one; a decoder must not exempt the word width from the minimality rule

vectors.name: overflow-33-bytes
vectors.notes: 33 bytes cannot fit the 32-byte EVM word
